name: PullToRefreshIndicator
description: The pull's indicator. Render it as the scroller's first child: by default it is the space the pull opens, with the DS Spinner in it, so the content moves down with the pull; on Android it is Material 3's own indicator, a disc with a progress arc that travels down over the content. It holds a polite live region that announces `label` while refreshing.

props.name: label
props.description: What a screen reader announces when the refresh starts, such as "Refreshing…". Product copy, so it comes from the consumer.
